archive.homeTitle: How to get the best item in No Man's Sky
archive.homeLead: Where is the best multitool, ship, or creature? In the database below: every multitool and every crashed ship whose four supercharged slots at class S are adjacent, and every creature you can adopt whose three grades are S, each with the portal glyphs and coordinates to get there. The guides tell where each kind of item comes from, from the galaxy down to the planet; the newest, the Forsaken Trader, shows where to find Haunting Mementos. The tools build what the game builds: every capital freighter shape, every Sentinel Interceptor, and How lucky am I? scores an item you found yourself. How it works tells why only a few systems make the list.
